instagram_composio_account: instagram_fast-orchat (@sai_healthy_corner) - ALWAYS pass explicitly, the default IG account is another client

how.carousel: IG: one INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA per slide with is_carousel_item=true (in order), then parent INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA media_type CAROUSEL children=[ids] caption, then INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA_PUBLISH. FB: FACEBOOK_CREATE_MULTI_PHOTO_POST page_id, photo_urls in order, message=caption.
how.reel: IG: INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA media_type REELS video_url, cover_url, share_to_feed true, caption; then INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA_PUBLISH max_wait_seconds 180. FB: already natively scheduled for the same time; only verify it published, else post it with FACEBOOK_CREATE_VIDEO_POST.
how.after: INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA for permalink; retry once on HTTP 500; tell the user in one line with links or the exact failure.
